Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value "true", only when the answer is a replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

site_id.description: Additive. Canonical site the plan is scoped to (a facility-layout Site site_code); empty for plans stored before migration 0008.

assigned_demand.description: The demand the plan was evaluated against (see demand_source), in orders.

demand_source.description: Additive (docs/adr/0004). "request": assigned_demand was stated by the caller (also every plan created before demand ingestion); "orders": it was omitted and defaulted from the order-management read model; "forecast": it was derived from the workload forecast of forecast_path_id (docs/adr/0024).

forecast_path_id.description: Additive (docs/adr/0024). The canonical path code of the workload forecast the demand was read from; present only when demand_source is "forecast".

scenario.description: Additive (docs/adr/0024). The plan's what-if label; absent when it carries none.

status.description: SUPERSEDED (additive, docs/adr/0024 decision 3) is terminal: a newer plan of the same site_id, location, path_id and window was published (superseded_by). Clients that switch on status must accept it.

path_capacity.description: Normalized path capacity, ORDER per HOUR.

capacity_over_window.description: path_capacity x window hours, in orders.

published_at.description: Present only once PUBLISHED (kept when SUPERSEDED).

superseded_by.description: Additive (docs/adr/0024 decision 3). The id of the plan whose publication superseded this one; present only when status is SUPERSEDED.

bottleneck_constraint.description: Additive. The constraint type binding the bottleneck step (e.g. LABOR or STATION); empty for plans created before it was recorded.

warnings.description: Additive. Composition warnings raised when the plan was created (never null).

inbound_appointments.description: Additive (docs/adr/0017). BOOKED dock appointments whose door window starts in the plan window. Informational: it sits NEXT TO assigned_demand (orders) and is never summed into it.

inbound_labour_minutes.description: Labour minutes the declared inbound standard for the plan's path attributes to those appointments; 0 without a standard.

inbound_average_heads.description: inbound_labour_minutes over the plan window length, in people.

inbound_standard_missing.description: True when appointments exist but no inbound standard is declared for the plan's (location, path_id); they contribute no labour demand.

labour_requirement.description: Additive (docs/adr/0022). The labour each step of the plan's path requires, in path order (never null; [] for plans stored before migration 0013).

items.description: Additive (docs/adr/0022). The labour one step of the plan's path requires: tasks x the engineered standard seconds of the step's task type (labor-performance's standard in force for the plan's site at the window start; a step's process type names its task type). Computed when the plan was created and stored with it: a later revision of a standard never rewrites it. Informational: the ORDER shortage, the bottleneck and every published event do not depend on it. When known is false the figures are 0 and reason says why.

standard_seconds.description: expected_seconds of the standard in force; 0 when there is none.

standard_site_scoped.description: True when that standard is scoped to the plan's site rather than every site.

tasks.description: Tasks the step's demand is (released lines for PICK with demand_source orders, else assigned_demand x tasks_per_order[step]).

required_average_heads.description: required_labour_hours over the plan window length, in people.

reason.description: Present only when known is false. no-labor-standard: no labor-performance standard of the step's task type is in force for the plan's site and window (or the step is not a task type it measures, e.g. REBIN). no-task-factor: a standard exists but the step's tasks cannot be counted (no tasks_per_order factor).

items.title: LabourRequirement

400.description: Malformed JSON body, malformed window_start/window_end, a window whose end is not after its start, or a missing/malformed Idempotency-Key (idempotency-key-required / idempotency-key-invalid).

409.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request (idempotency-key-reused).

422.description: A path step has no ProcessCapacity registered for this location/window; a WorkloadProfile factor is missing, not positive, or cannot normalize a step's unit; assigned_demand is negative, or is omitted and the order-demand read model has no order for this location and window (missing-assigned-demand); a tasks_per_order value is not positive (non-positive-tasks-per-order); site_id is absent/blank; or warehouse_id/location/path_id is blank. demand_source (docs/adr/0024): an unknown value (unknown-demand-source), an input the source does not read (demand-source-conflict), demand_source forecast without units_per_order (missing-units-per-order) or with no forecast bucket in the window (missing-assigned-demand); a scenario label that is empty or longer than 64 characters (invalid-scenario).

500.description: An unexpected failure (a store or outbox error). Answered as problem+json (internal-error). A 5xx answer is never stored under an Idempotency-Key and rolls back the aggregate change and its outbox rows, so the retry re-executes.
